content.text: Help my eyes see day and night!
Grow up strong, hip hip hooray!
One more bite, give it a try,
A rainbow on my plate today,

position.expression: if time>=7.50 and time<36.40 then local b=math.abs(math.sin(math.pi*(time-7.50)/0.59)); return value+Vec.v2(0,-40*b) end; return value

scale.expression: local b=0; local C={}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+0.7)%3.9; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; return Vec.v2(0.9574,0.9574*k)

opacity.expression: local b=0; local C={}; for i=1,#C,2 do if time>=C[i] and time<C[i+1] then b=1 end end; local p=(time+0.7)%3.9; local k=0; if p<0.08 then k=p/0.08 elseif p<0.13 then k=1 elseif p<0.21 then k=(0.21-p)/0.08 end; if b==1 then k=1 end; if k>0.85 then return 1 end; return 0
